executionAuthorization.scope: Phase 12-1 orphan semantic tags only (309 CERTIFIED assignments); the 2 unresolvedTagConcepts and the 876 non-orphan talents are out of scope
executionAuthorization.note: QA3 is the final semantic payload. Only these execution-metadata fields differ from the supplied QA3 file; no auditKey, canonicalId, finalTags, rationale, sourceAuthority, QA result or deferred decision was changed. Rationale strings are preserved verbatim, including the mojibake in a few JATM rationales. Reconciliation (2026-10-02): at the owner's instruction the 11 Phase 12-1 revisions of the global QA (QA-1..QA-5) sweep were applied on top of QA3; see globalQaReconciliation. Only those 11 finalTags arrays changed (array order taken from the global-QA file).

policy.designAuthority: Human/system designers make all semantic decisions; Claude performs no semantic interpretation.
sourceOrder: PDF source only when TXT is absent, clipped, malformed, or materially ambiguous
policy.vocabulary: Use only tags surviving Phase 11 pruning unless owner/system designers later approve a new concept.
policy.taggingStandard: Assign the complete justified semantic/mechanical/scope/play-behavior tag set; one tag is sufficient only when it fully represents the talent.
policy.unresolvedPolicy: If the surviving vocabulary cannot accurately represent the talent, do not force a weak tag. Put it in unresolvedTagConcepts for later designer adjudication.
policy.execution: Claude must write exact finalTags arrays from this manifest and must not add, remove, substitute, normalize, or infer tags.

assignments.name: Arrogant Bluster
assignments.rationale: Persuasion-based social control that lowers Will Defense; optional Force Point extends duration.

assignments.name: Band Together
assignments.rationale: Three once-per-encounter leadership/support modes: designate a damage target, bolster allied Will, or recruit/direct a temporary ally.

assignments.name: Sense Primal Force
assignments.rationale: Expands Force-based Sense Surroundings in natural wilderness to detect targets through line-of-sight limits.

assignments.name: Coordinated Leadership
assignments.rationale: Improves one Leadership talent so its granted bonuses stack with allied bonuses.

assignments.name: Oafish
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter salvages a failed Deception or Persuasion check by adding a bonus.

assignments.name: Outsider's Query
assignments.rationale: Mitigates a failed attitude-change check and grants an additional Persuasion attempt.

assignments.name: Rant
assignments.rationale: Successful intimidation denies an enemy move action and immediately grants an ally a move action as a reaction.

assignments.name: Self-Reliant
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter converts an Inspiration talent that normally supports others into self-support.

assignments.name: Wary
assignments.rationale: Detecting failed enemy Stealth/Deception grants immediate reactive movement.

assignments.name: Deep Space Raider
assignments.rationale: Vehicle/starship raiding package: force reposition/disengage, fire while escaping, and disable vehicle systems.

assignments.name: Extended Ambush
assignments.rationale: During a surprise round, converts aiming into a free setup for a ranged attack against a surprised target.

assignments.name: Piercing Hit
assignments.rationale: Three once-per-encounter attack modes compromise armor/flat-foot the target, impair attacks and vision, or reduce speed.

assignments.name: Quicktrap
assignments.rationale: Speeds Tripwire setup from a standard action to a move action.

assignments.name: Silent Movement
assignments.rationale: Removes environmental noise penalties from Stealth and provides automatic aid to an ally's Stealth check.

assignments.name: Speedclimber
assignments.rationale: Removes the penalty for accelerated climbing.

assignments.name: Surprisingly Quick
assignments.rationale: Adds a swift action during the surprise round, even when surprised.

assignments.name: Battle Mount
assignments.rationale: Mounted-combat package improves cover and lets rider or mount attack under compressed action timing.

assignments.name: Mechanized Rider
assignments.rationale: Extends Ride applications to speeder bikes/swoops using Pilot/Ride expertise.

assignments.name: Terrain Guidance
assignments.rationale: Swift Ride check lets a mount ignore difficult-terrain speed loss.

assignments.name: Champion
assignments.rationale: Three champion modes improve second-wind recovery, convert threshold damage into a disarm, or scale melee/unarmed damage from attack margin.

assignments.name: Out of Harm's Way
assignments.rationale: Reactive ally-protection repositioning swaps protector and protected ally without provoking.

assignments.name: Simple Opportunity
assignments.rationale: Allows ranged/thrown simple weapons to make attacks of opportunity and therefore exert ranged threat/control.

assignments.name: Warrior's Determination
assignments.rationale: Reactive resistance ignores a non-Force effect that beats Will; Force Point extends protection to mind-affecting Force effects.

assignments.name: Familiar Enemies
assignments.rationale: Expands familiar-foe target designation to a second enemy.

assignments.name: Familiar Situation
assignments.rationale: Extends familiar-foe benefits into Fortitude/Will defense against the designated target.

assignments.name: Fast Attack Specialist
assignments.rationale: Compresses a vehicle full attack into a standard action and permits an extra encounter use via Force Point.

assignments.name: Master Manipulator
assignments.rationale: Successful Persuasion immediately enables a second Persuasion use against the same target.

assignments.name: Overcharged Shot
assignments.rationale: Swift overcharge boosts the next vehicle-energy-weapon hit by one die with a subsequent damage drawback.

assignments.name: Quick Cuffs
assignments.rationale: After a successful grab, swiftly applies binders to restrain the target.

assignments.name: Roll Out
assignments.rationale: Rerolls Pilot to disengage from a dogfight and mitigates failure for vehicle gunners.

assignments.name: Small Favor
assignments.rationale: Uses social contacts to obtain information and grant a major bonus to Gather Information or Knowledge.

assignments.name: Extended Critical Range (simple weapons)
assignments.rationale: Extends simple-weapon critical threat range without making non-20 rolls automatic hits.

assignments.name: Extended Threat
assignments.rationale: Extends ranged attack-of-opportunity threat to a 2-square radius.

assignments.name: Master's Orders
assignments.rationale: Allies using actions granted by you may reroll an attack or check made during that action.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (simple weapons)
assignments.rationale: Reduces full-attack penalties for repeated attacks with simple weapons; repeated selections stack.

assignments.name: Two-For-One Throw
assignments.rationale: Standard action makes two simultaneous thrown-weapon attacks against one target/space.

assignments.name: Irregular Tactics
assignments.rationale: Knowledge (tactics) after share talent establishes a defensive DC against enemy Military Tactics effects.

assignments.name: Lead by Example
assignments.rationale: Enhances a shared talent when you demonstrated it first, improving DC/bonuses or reducing damage taken.

assignments.name: Lingering Debilitation
assignments.rationale: Debilitating Shot can impose a persistent condition that remains after the normal condition-track hit.

assignments.name: Retreating Fire
assignments.rationale: Makes a ranged attack while running/withdrawing; Force Point removes the attack penalty.

assignments.name: Slowing Shot
assignments.rationale: Debilitating Shot additionally reduces speed, removes Dexterity to Reflex, and flat-foots the target; Force Point deepens slow.

assignments.name: Swift Shot
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter compresses a handheld ranged attack from standard to swift action.

assignments.name: Turn the Tide
assignments.rationale: Tactics check forces affected enemies to reroll Initiative next round while allies may choose to reroll.

assignments.name: Force Directed Shot
assignments.rationale: Force-guided ranged attack treats a chosen visible square as the shot origin for cover/concealment.

assignments.name: Negate and Redirect
assignments.rationale: After negate energy succeeds, converts part of the negated ranged energy into an immediate Force-based counterstrike.

assignments.name: Rising Anger
assignments.rationale: Reactive ally-harm trigger builds a stacking morale bonus to the next attack, up to +5.

assignments.name: Anticipate Movement
assignments.rationale: Reactive enemy-movement trigger grants a visible ally immediate free movement up to speed.

assignments.name: Heavy Fire Zone
assignments.rationale: Swiftly establishes a 3x3 control zone that converts enemy entry into an allied attack of opportunity.

assignments.name: Prime Targets
assignments.rationale: A lightsaber hit against a target not attacked since your last turn gains one extra damage die, rewarding fresh-target selection.

assignments.name: Commanding Presence
assignments.rationale: Three command attacks can bolster allied defenses, allied attack/damage, or immediate allied movement.

assignments.name: Easy Prey
assignments.rationale: Trades half of one standard-action attack's damage to deny that target Dexterity to Reflex against your attacks until the end of your next turn.

assignments.name: Quick Strike
assignments.rationale: During the initial round, damaging an enemy that has not acted grants an immediate free attack against a different nearby target.

assignments.name: Sly Combatant
assignments.rationale: Three once-per-encounter attacks impose lasting offensive penalties, a persistent injury, or scaling damage from allied adjacency.

assignments.name: Summon Aid
assignments.rationale: Enemy movement adjacent to you triggers an immediate allied charge against that enemy.

assignments.name: Tactical Savvy
assignments.rationale: Improves a visible ally's Force Point roll when that ally spends the point to enhance an attack roll.

assignments.name: Backstabber
assignments.rationale: While flanking, once per turn one attack treats the target as flat-footed.

assignments.name: Dig In
assignments.rationale: While prone, a swift action grants temporary concealment until you move or stand.

assignments.name: Ghost Assailant
assignments.rationale: From total cover/concealment, a swift opposed Stealth check makes the target flat-footed against you for the turn.

assignments.name: Improved Sneak Attack
assignments.rationale: Extends the range at which Sneak Attack can apply from 6 squares to 12 squares.

assignments.name: Mobile Combatant
assignments.rationale: Three mobile-combat modes pair attacks with Reflex defense, safe repositioning, or reactive withdrawal that sets up the next attack.

assignments.name: Slip By
assignments.rationale: When movement would provoke, substitutes a Stealth check result for Reflex Defense against the attack of opportunity if higher.

assignments.name: Trailblazer
assignments.rationale: A swift action lets nearby visible allies ignore the first square of difficult terrain each time they move.

assignments.name: Battlefield Remedy
assignments.rationale: Successful First Aid also moves the patient one positive step on the condition track.

assignments.name: Defensive Jab
assignments.rationale: Fighting defensively while unarmed grants a free unarmed attack against an adjacent target.

assignments.name: Defensive Position
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions upgrade existing cover to improved cover until the start of your next turn.

assignments.name: Grizzled Warrior
assignments.rationale: Three veteran actions grant Constitution-based bonus hit points, improve an aided ally's successful attack with level-scaled damage, or grant +2 Reflex after attacking.

assignments.name: Nimble Dodge
assignments.rationale: A missed enemy melee attack lets you reactively move up to 2 squares while ending adjacent to the attacker.

assignments.name: Stunning Shockboxer
assignments.rationale: An unarmed stun attack adds one extra damage die to the hit-point damage remaining after stun damage is halved.

assignments.name: Autofire Assault
assignments.rationale: Allows a proficient autofire-capable weapon to be braced even when it is not restricted to autofire only.

assignments.name: Reckless
assignments.rationale: A successful charge attack adds your Wisdom bonus to damage.

assignments.name: Ferocious Assault
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter converts an autofire attack into a 6-square cone at the cost of 20 shots.

assignments.name: Bullseye
assignments.rationale: Against an aimed non-point-blank target, one ranged attack denies the target its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.

assignments.name: Fall Back
assignments.rationale: A move action orders every squad member to move 2 squares without provoking attacks of opportunity.

assignments.name: Form Up
assignments.rationale: A move action grants squad members a morale bonus to Reflex Defense while they remain mutually supported by nearby squadmates.

assignments.name: Full Advance
assignments.rationale: A move action grants all squad members a morale bonus to damage until the end of your next turn.

assignments.name: Harrying Shot
assignments.rationale: An aimed damaging ranged hit prevents the target from using a standard action to make an attack on its next turn; the effect is stunning.

assignments.name: Hold Steady
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a standard command action moves every squad member one positive step on the condition track.

assignments.name: Keep Them Honest
assignments.rationale: Using Aid Another to suppress an enemy imposes a much larger attack penalty on that enemy until the end of your next turn.

assignments.name: Search and Destroy
assignments.rationale: A move action grants the squad a morale bonus to Perception checks until the end of your next turn.

assignments.name: Echani Expertise
assignments.rationale: Extends the critical threat range of unarmed attacks by one while preserving the natural-20 automatic-hit rule.

assignments.name: Hijkata Expertise
assignments.rationale: An unarmed hit penalizes the target's next attack roll by an amount equal to your Strength bonus.

assignments.name: Flurry of Blows
assignments.rationale: Reduces multiple-unarmed-attack full-attack penalties by 2; repeated selections reduce the penalty further.

assignments.name: Hardened Strike
assignments.rationale: Damaging an opponent unarmed reduces its Damage Reduction by 1 for the encounter, enabling later attacks; repeated hits do not stack.

assignments.name: K'tara Expertise
assignments.rationale: Once per turn after unarmed damage, makes a disarm attempt as a swift action and removes the normal two-handed-weapon disarm penalty.

assignments.name: K'thri Expertise
assignments.rationale: Enemies beginning their turns adjacent take Strength-based damage when you are able to make an attack of opportunity against them.

assignments.name: Punishing Strike
assignments.rationale: Once per turn, an unarmed critical hit grants an immediate additional unarmed attack against a target within reach.

assignments.name: Stava Expertise
assignments.rationale: A successful grab forces an opposed grapple check to escape, and grapple checks you initiate can be rerolled with the second result required.

assignments.name: Tae-Jitsu Expertise
assignments.rationale: Once per turn, an unarmed hit whose attack roll meets the target's damage threshold moves that target one step down the condition track regardless of damage.

assignments.name: Wrruushi Expertise
assignments.rationale: Once per turn after unarmed damage, a free attack against Fortitude can restrict the target to a single swift action on its next turn.

assignments.name: Regimen Aptitude
assignments.rationale: Improves skill checks made to perform Force regimens, directly representing Force training expressed through skill use.

assignments.name: Echoes in the Force
assignments.rationale: Extends farseeing from creatures to locations and lets the user investigate meaningful events in a locationâs past through a Use the Force check.

assignments.name: Unclouded Judgment
assignments.rationale: As a reaction, spends a Force Point to completely negate a mind-affecting Force power or talent targeting the user.

assignments.name: Improvised Weapon Master
assignments.rationale: Removes the attack-roll penalty for improvised weapons, improving accuracy with that weapon scope.

assignments.name: Folded Space Mastery
assignments.rationale: Uses fold space to move a piloted vehicle across hyperspace-scale distances and substitutes Use the Force for the normal Use Computer hyperspace calculation.

assignments.name: Liberate
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point as a swift action to free a nearby ally from grab, grapple, or immobilization and immediately lets that ally move as a reaction.

assignments.name: Many Shades of the Force
assignments.rationale: Changes one selected Force power so its dark-side or light-side descriptor no longer applies to the user.

assignments.name: Spatial Integrity
assignments.rationale: While aboard a vehicle, spends a Force Point as a reaction and uses a Use the Force check to reduce damage the vehicle takes after DR and SR.

assignments.name: Expanded Horizon
assignments.rationale: Extends Search Your Feelings farther into the future, with Force Point or Destiny Point expenditure increasing the forecasting window.

assignments.name: Knowledge and Defense
assignments.rationale: Adds Wisdom to Reflex Defense specifically when Dexterity would be denied, preserving defense in vulnerable states.

assignments.name: Planetary Attunement
assignments.rationale: Force-attunes to a planet to improve defenses against natural hazards, increase speed, and sense local weather up to a day ahead.

assignments.name: Precognitive Meditation
assignments.rationale: A daily precognitive meditation spends a Force Point to bank a future attack negation for the user or a vehicle the user pilots.

assignments.name: Immerse Another
assignments.rationale: Lets an adjacent ally use the userâs Stealth or Use the Force result to avoid detection, with a Force Point extending the protection to all adjacent allies.

assignments.name: Ride the Current
assignments.rationale: After taking damage, spends a Force Point as a reaction to gain total concealment and can immediately take an unused second wind.

assignments.name: Surrender to the Current
assignments.rationale: Enters a sustained state that restricts Force powers to self-targeting effects but recovers one spent qualifying Force power each turn as a swift action without a Force Point.

assignments.name: Body Control
assignments.rationale: Uses Charisma in place of Constitution for Fortitude Defense and can spend a Force Point as a swift action to become immune to poison, radiation, and disease for the encounter.

assignments.name: Physical Surge
assignments.rationale: At the start of combat, grants an immediate swift action when Initiative is rolled even if the character is surprised.

assignments.name: Soft to Solid

sourceAuthority.file: SW Saga - Jedi Academy Training Manual (optimized).pdf

assignments.rationale: After being damaged, spends a Force Point as a reaction to gain DR 10 until the end of the next turn.

assignments.name: Wan-Shen Defense
assignments.rationale: Uses a wan-shen as a swift-action defensive stance that grants a scaling deflection bonus to Reflex Defense against melee attacks.

assignments.name: Wan-Shen Mastery
assignments.rationale: Compresses two wan-shen attacks against different targets within reach into a single standard action.

assignments.name: Mobile Whirlwind
assignments.rationale: Adds full-speed movement after resolving Whirlwind Attack, turning the attack into a strong repositioning tool.

assignments.name: Repelling Whirlwind
assignments.rationale: After Whirlwind Attack, grants a Reflex Defense bonus against every target hit until the start of the userâs next turn.

assignments.name: Sudden Storm
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point to replace the normal melee attack at the end of a charge with an unarmed Whirlwind Attack.

assignments.name: Tempest Tossed
assignments.rationale: A damaging Whirlwind Attack can reposition each affected target by one square as a free action.

assignments.name: Combustion

sourceAuthority.file: SW Saga - Jedi Academy Training Manual (optimized).pdf

assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point as a swift action to add fire damage to a single-target damaging Force power and causes the damaged target to catch fire.

assignments.name: Earth Buckle
assignments.rationale: Creates a 3x3 area of difficult terrain as a swift action while allowing the user to ignore the movement penalties of that terrain.

assignments.name: Fluidity
assignments.rationale: Substitutes Use the Force for Acrobatics, carries applicable rerolls to the substituted check, and can spend a Force Point to improve effective size for grapple checks.

assignments.name: Thunderclap
assignments.rationale: A damaging Force power can also trigger Bantha Rush against the target, adding forced movement/control to Force offense.

assignments.name: Wind Vortex
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point as a swift action to gain encounter-long concealment plus additional Reflex Defense against thrown weapons.

assignments.name: Cycle of Harmony
assignments.rationale: When one nearby ally is hurt or moved down the condition track, reacts by granting scaling bonus hit points to a different nearby ally.

assignments.name: Force Stabilize
assignments.rationale: Once per turn as a swift action, lets a nearby ally immediately take an unused second wind.

assignments.name: Repel Discord
assignments.rationale: When targeted by a dark-side Force power, spends a Force Point as a reaction to penalize the attackerâs activation check by the attackerâs Dark Side Score.

assignments.name: Stifle Conflict
assignments.rationale: Allows any damaging Force power the user activates to deal stun damage instead of normal damage.

assignments.name: Brutal Unarmed Strike
assignments.rationale: Improves every unarmed damage roll by rerolling damage dice that show 1.

assignments.name: Martial Resurgence
assignments.rationale: A natural 20 on an unarmed attack restores all spent Force powers to the userâs Force suite.

assignments.name: Rebound Leap
assignments.rationale: Dropping an opponent to 0 hit points with an unarmed attack grants an immediate Jump-based movement as a free action.

assignments.name: Simultaneous Strike
assignments.rationale: Makes two unarmed attacks against different targets as a single standard action.

assignments.name: Telekinetic Throw
assignments.rationale: Extends the Throw feat so a successfully thrown grappled opponent can land prone up to three squares beyond the userâs reach.

assignments.name: Discblade Arc
assignments.rationale: Uses a discblade for a full-round area attack against three designated targets within point-blank range with one attack roll.

assignments.name: Distant Discblade Throw
assignments.rationale: Treats a discblade as a pistol rather than a thrown weapon solely for determining range.

assignments.name: Recall Discblade
assignments.rationale: After a ranged discblade attack, a Use the Force check calls the weapon back to the userâs hand as a free action.

assignments.name: Telekinetic Vigilance
assignments.rationale: Returns the intercept Force power to the userâs Force suite as a swift action without spending a Force Point.

assignments.name: Weapon Specialization (discblade)
assignments.rationale: Grants a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls with the exotic discblade.

assignments.name: Idealist
assignments.rationale: Substitutes Charisma for Wisdom when determining Will Defense, strengthening mental defense through an alternate ability basis.

assignments.name: Influential Friends
assignments.rationale: Calls on established contacts to produce an automatic high skill-check result on the character's behalf, with the modifier scaling by heroic level.

assignments.name: Willpower
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a swift action grants all visible allies a lasting morale bonus to Will Defense.

assignments.name: Improved Surveillance
assignments.rationale: A successful Surveillance use designates the observed target and grants the user and allies an insight bonus to all defenses against that target.

assignments.name: Ruthless
assignments.rationale: Exceeding a target's damage threshold with a melee or ranged attack grants a persistent damage bonus against that target for the encounter.

assignments.name: Extended Critical Range (heavy weapons)
assignments.rationale: Extends the critical threat range of heavy weapons while preserving the natural-20 automatic-hit rule.

assignments.name: Computer Language
assignments.rationale: Substitutes Persuasion for Use Computer, including training qualification and any rerolls that would apply to the original Use Computer check.

assignments.name: Computer Master
assignments.rationale: Allows opposed Use Computer checks to be rerolled while keeping the better result.

assignments.name: Enhanced Manipulation
assignments.rationale: Allows taking 10 on any Dexterity-based skill check even under threat or circumstances that normally prevent taking 10.

assignments.name: Hotwired Processor
assignments.rationale: A swift-action processor overclock grants temporary bonuses to Intelligence/Wisdom skill checks and ranged attacks, scaling in duration by level, followed by a persistent condition penalty.

assignments.name: Skill Conversion
assignments.rationale: During reprogramming, converts one trained skill into a bonus Skill Focus feat for another trained skill.

assignments.name: Attract Privateer
assignments.rationale: Attracts a loyal nonheroic privateer lieutenant whose class level scales with the character; repeated selections add additional followers.

assignments.name: Ion Mastery
assignments.rationale: Improves ion-weapon accuracy and ion damage against the droid/vehicle targets that ion weapons are designed to disable rather than destroy.

assignments.name: Multiattack Proficiency (advanced melee weapons)
assignments.rationale: Reduces full-attack penalties for multiple attacks with advanced melee weapons; repeated selections reduce the penalty further.

assignments.name: Conceal Other
assignments.rationale: Extends Buried Presence or Vanish to adjacent willing allies, with repeated selections increasing the number of allies concealed.

assignments.name: Insightful Aim
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point as a swift action to substitute the Use the Force modifier for ranged attack bonus until the next turn.

assignments.name: Vanish
assignments.rationale: A swift Use the Force check can grant total concealment from one target until the next turn or until the user acts against that target.

assignments.name: Detonate
assignments.rationale: Spending a Force Point when using Force blast expands the effect into a secondary 2-square area attack around the original target.

assignments.name: Hive Mind
assignments.rationale: Makes the Telepathy application of Use the Force a swift action and automatically succeeds with a willing recipient on the same planet.

assignments.name: Infuse Weapon
assignments.rationale: Force-infuses an unpowered melee weapon, improving its resistance to damage and lightsabers and adding damage when a Force Point is used to improve its attack.

assignments.name: Sickening Blast
assignments.rationale: A Force blast that beats Fortitude can also move the target down the condition track at the cost of increasing the user's Dark Side Score.

assignments.name: Adept Assistant
assignments.rationale: Greatly improves Aid Another when assisting an ally with Mechanics, Pilot, or Use Computer.

assignments.name: Dull the Pain
assignments.rationale: A Treat Injury check on an adjacent living creature moves that creature one positive step on the condition track.

assignments.name: Interrogator
assignments.rationale: Substitutes Treat Injury for Persuasion when changing attitude or intimidating an adjacent target, combining medical expertise with social coercion.

assignments.name: Mechanics Mastery
assignments.rationale: Allows taking 10 on Mechanics checks even when distractions or hazards would normally prevent it.

assignments.name: Vehicle Mechanic
assignments.rationale: Over three successive swift actions, a Mechanics check restores vehicle hit points and moves the vehicle one positive step on the condition track, with extra healing for exceeding the DC.

assignments.name: Cargo Hauler
assignments.rationale: Improves Strength-based skill performance and doubles carrying capacity, representing enhanced Strength-derived capability.

assignments.name: Combat Repairs
assignments.rationale: Once per day, compresses the repair-droid application of Mechanics into a full-round self-repair instead of the normal hour.

assignments.name: Droid Smash
assignments.rationale: Doubles the Strength contribution to one-handed melee weapon damage.

assignments.name: Environmentally Shielded
assignments.rationale: Provides an equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense against environmental hazards such as extreme atmospheres and corrosion.

assignments.name: Etiquette
assignments.rationale: A successful Persuasion check to change attitude shifts the target one additional attitude step.

assignments.name: Helpful
assignments.rationale: Once per turn, compresses Aid Another on an adjacent ally's skill check from a standard action to a swift action.

assignments.name: Power Supply
assignments.rationale: Reroutes internal power to operate generator-dependent equipment and reduces the swift-action cost of recharging shields or rerouting vehicle/starship power.

assignments.name: Protocol
assignments.rationale: Automatically succeeds on Aid Another attempts involving Deception, Knowledge, or Persuasion.

assignments.name: Targeting Package
assignments.rationale: Two swift actions activate targeting software that boosts the next point-blank or melee attack and damage roll if line of sight and action sequencing are preserved.

assignments.name: Blend In
assignments.rationale: A swift action converts adjacency to a crowd into total concealment against nonadjacent attackers, creating a positional defensive state.

assignments.name: Get into Position
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter at the start of the user's first turn, two visible allies can immediately move up to speed as reactions, establishing opening positions.

assignments.name: Guaranteed Boon
assignments.rationale: A Force Point spent on a failed skill-challenge check is refunded, preserving the resource when the boosted check still fails.

assignments.name: Leading Skill
assignments.rationale: A skill-challenge success sets up a +2 insight bonus on the user's next check with a different skill in the same challenge.

assignments.name: Learn from Mistakes
assignments.rationale: A failed skill-challenge action creates a +2 insight setup bonus for the next ally who attempts a different action with a different skill.

assignments.name: Master Manipulator
assignments.rationale: Three once-per-encounter manipulation modes recover an ally and bolster attacks/skills, replace a visible character's d20 result, or temporarily substitute the user's defense score for an ally's.

assignments.name: Retaliation
assignments.rationale: After threshold damage moves the user down the condition track, the next damaging melee or ranged hit before the end of the next turn also moves the target down one condition step.

assignments.name: Try Your Luck
assignments.rationale: A failed skill-challenge check sets up an ally to roll the same skill twice and keep the better result later in the challenge.

assignments.name: Bomb Thrower
assignments.rationale: Improves Mechanics for explosives and permits field-crafting a frag-grenade equivalent from suitable spare parts.

assignments.name: For the Cause
assignments.rationale: Threshold-exceeding damage to the user or a nearby ally triggers a short-lived group bonus to attack and damage rolls within 6 squares.

assignments.name: Fade Out
assignments.rationale: Uses Stealth in place of Deception to create a diversion to hide, with trained Deception improving the substituted check.

assignments.name: Keep Together
assignments.rationale: Any melee or ranged attack hit or miss can trigger full-speed reactive movement that must end adjacent to an ally and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

assignments.name: Prudent Escape
assignments.rationale: Dropping or incapacitating a target lets the user and two nearby visible allies immediately move up to speed as reactions without provoking opportunity attacks.

assignments.name: Reactive Stealth
assignments.rationale: A missed ranged attack while the user has cover or concealment can trigger half-speed movement followed by a Stealth attempt to become hidden.

assignments.name: Revolutionary Rhetoric
assignments.rationale: A standard-action Persuasion check against Will imposes a mind-affecting action restriction, limiting the target to move and swift actions until the end of the next turn unless attacked.

assignments.name: Coordinated Effort
assignments.rationale: Aid Another on the Dedicated Protector target's attack also grants that ally a +2 damage bonus, improving coordinated melee or ranged offense.

assignments.name: Crowd Control
assignments.rationale: Expands the grab mechanic to restrain two adjacent creatures simultaneously, increasing close-range control coverage.

assignments.name: Disarm and Engage
assignments.rationale: A successful disarm immediately converts the captured weapon into a free follow-up attack, creating control plus burst offense regardless of whether the weapon is melee or ranged.

assignments.name: Reverse Strength
assignments.rationale: A successful grapple deals damage based on the opponent's Strength modifier, turning close-control success into scaling damage.

assignments.name: Sizing Up
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a Perception check against a visible target's Will designates that target for encounter-long bonuses to the user's attacks and skill checks against it.

assignments.name: Clip
assignments.rationale: When ramming, the user's ship is treated as two size categories smaller only for collision damage it receives, improving vehicle durability without reducing damage dealt to the target.

assignments.name: Dedicated Guardian
assignments.rationale: Three once-per-encounter protector modes grant an ally area-attack defense, transfer condition-track loss from the ally to the user, or create flanking through adjacency.

assignments.name: Master Defender
assignments.rationale: Fighting defensively trades attack accuracy for a large dodge bonus to the vehicle's Reflex Defense, with the attack penalty shared by the user and gunners.

assignments.name: Shunt Damage
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, a Pilot check can redirect damage from the user's ship to an adjacent allied ship, protecting the user's vehicle through positional damage shunting.

assignments.name: Attract Superior Minion
assignments.rationale: Upgrades Attract Minion to provide a nonheroic follower whose class level scales directly with the user's character level.

assignments.name: Contingency Plan
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, failure on an attack, skill check, or opposed-check talent can be converted into immediate full-speed reactive movement.

assignments.name: Damaging Disarm
assignments.rationale: A successful ranged disarm retains half the attack's damage, combining ranged precision/control with direct damage.

assignments.name: Revealing Secrets
assignments.rationale: Gather Information checks for secret information become substantially easier and cheaper, improving investigative social-network access to hidden information.

assignments.name: Ignite Fervor
assignments.rationale: After the user hits with a melee or ranged attack, a free action grants one visible ally level-scaled bonus damage on that ally's next attack.

assignments.name: Improved Weaken Resolve
assignments.rationale: Enhances Weaken Resolve so its damage-threshold-triggered, Persuasion-vs-Will fear effect continues forcing the target to flee even after the target is wounded.

assignments.name: Weaken Resolve
assignments.rationale: Once per round after dealing threshold-level damage, a free-action Persuasion check against Will can force a lower-level target to flee; a Force Point can negate the mind-affecting fear effect.

assignments.name: Coordinate
assignments.rationale: A standard action improves the Aid Another bonuses granted by visible allies, with repeated selections increasing the bonus up to +5.

assignments.name: Distant Command
assignments.rationale: Extends Born Leader support so affected allies retain its benefit even after line of sight to the leader is broken.

assignments.name: Fearless Leader
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants allies an encounter-long morale bonus to Will Defense against fear while they retain line of sight to the leader.

assignments.name: Wealth
assignments.rationale: Provides recurring credits equal to 5,000 times noble level whenever the character gains a level.

assignments.name: Walk the Line
assignments.rationale: A standard action imposes a temporary penalty to all defenses on every visible opponent within 6 squares, creating broad short-duration battlefield vulnerability.

assignments.name: Hyperdriven
assignments.rationale: Once per day aboard a starship, adds class level to one attack roll, skill check, or ability check, with the bonus allowed after seeing the original result.

assignments.name: Starship Raider
assignments.rationale: Provides a persistent +1 attack bonus while aboard a starship, applying to both starship weapons and personal weapons used aboard the vessel.

assignments.name: Total Concealment
assignments.rationale: Upgrades any source of concealment into total concealment, materially improving stealth, defense, and evasion.

assignments.name: Unbalance Opponent
assignments.rationale: Designates a size-comparable opponent and suppresses that opponent's Strength bonus on attack rolls against the user, improving melee defense through targeted control.

assignments.name: Devastating Attack
assignments.rationale: For a chosen proficient exotic weapon or weapon group, successful attacks treat the target's Damage Threshold as 5 lower; Heavy Weapons can extend the mechanic to vehicle weapon attacks.

assignments.name: Attune Armor
assignments.rationale: A full-round Force Point expenditure permanently modifies a suit of armor for the user, increasing its armor bonus and maximum Dexterity bonus.

assignments.name: Charm Beast
assignments.rationale: Substitutes Use the Force for Persuasion when changing the attitude of low-Intelligence undomesticated creatures and removes the normal language penalty.

assignments.name: Command Beast
assignments.rationale: Turns a beast whose attitude has been improved to indifferent or friendly into a domesticated animal for the user and permits qualifying beasts to serve as mounts.

assignments.name: Flight
assignments.rationale: A swift-action Force Point expenditure grants temporary flight at land speed, with altered ascent/descent rates until the start of the next turn.

assignments.name: Force Cloak Mastery
assignments.rationale: Expands Force Cloak from self-only protection to a bubble covering a number of creatures, including the user, equal to character level while retaining the cloak's sensor/surveillance concealment.

assignments.name: Linked Defense
assignments.rationale: A swift action trades up to -5 from the user's attacks for an equal Force bonus to a visible ally's Reflex Defense, capped by base attack bonus.

assignments.name: Dogfight Gunner
assignments.rationale: Removes the normal dogfight attack penalty from vehicle-weapon attacks even when the user is serving as gunner rather than pilot.

assignments.name: Quick Trigger
assignments.rationale: Enemy vehicle movement out of the user's square or an adjacent square triggers a vehicle attack as an attack of opportunity.

assignments.name: Relentless Pursuit
assignments.rationale: Rolls twice and keeps the better result on opposed Pilot checks made to initiate a dogfight.

assignments.name: Notorious
assignments.rationale: When undisguised, rerolls Persuasion checks made to intimidate and keeps the better result.

assignments.name: Exotic Weapon Mastery
assignments.rationale: Treats the user as proficient with every exotic weapon, removing the normal need for individual Exotic Weapon Proficiency feats.

assignments.name: Greater Weapon Specialization
assignments.rationale: For a chosen exotic weapon or weapon group, grants another +2 damage that stacks with Weapon Specialization; the selectable groups span melee and ranged weapons.

assignments.name: Severing Strike
assignments.rationale: When a lightsaber hit would otherwise kill and also meets the target's Damage Threshold, converts the attack into half damage, a condition-track penalty, and a precise limb-severing injury with lasting combat/mobility penalties.

assignments.name: Shift Defense II
assignments.rationale: A swift action trades a -5 penalty to one defense for a +2 competence bonus to another defense until the next turn.

assignments.name: Shift Defense III
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants +5 competence to one defense by imposing -5 on the other two defenses until the next turn.

assignments.name: Directed Movement
assignments.rationale: A move action grants one droid its movement, permits movement-related skill checks during that movement, and lets those checks use the controller's Intelligence modifier in place of the droid's relevant ability modifier.

assignments.name: Full Control
assignments.rationale: A full-round action grants one droid a full attack and lets its attack rolls use the controller's Intelligence modifier in place of the droid's relevant ability modifier.

assignments.name: Remote Attack
assignments.rationale: A standard action grants one droid a melee or ranged attack and lets that attack roll use the controller's Intelligence modifier in place of the droid's relevant ability modifier.

assignments.name: Known Vulnerability
assignments.rationale: A life-sciences check identifies a species' vulnerable points; for the encounter, damaging melee or unarmed hits against that species impose an attack penalty through the user's next turn.

assignments.name: Medical Analyzer
assignments.rationale: For a medical droid, adds Intelligence to Treat Injury checks used to treat disease, poison, or radiation, improving medical-condition treatment rather than direct hit-point healing.

assignments.name: Science Analyzer
assignments.rationale: Adds double the user's Intelligence modifier to Knowledge (life sciences) or Knowledge (physical sciences) checks.

assignments.name: Triage Scan
assignments.rationale: A standard-action Treat Injury check scans nearby visible organic characters and identifies who is below half hit points and each target's condition-track position.

assignments.name: On-Board System Link
assignments.rationale: While physically linked to a vehicle or starship, reduces the action cost of rerouting power or recharging shields from three swift actions to two.

assignments.name: Quick Astrogation
assignments.rationale: Cuts astrogation calculation time in half and allows an Astrogate Use Computer check as a standard action instead of a full-round action.

assignments.name: Scomp Link Slicer
assignments.rationale: While physically linked to a computer, provides three once-per-encounter slicing advantages: faster program eradication, opposed-check lockout control, and reaction-based prevention of tracing.

assignments.name: Nuanced
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, adds the user's Wisdom bonus in addition to Charisma bonus on a Persuasion check.

assignments.name: Supervising Droid
assignments.rationale: Provides three once-per-encounter supervisory modes for droid allies: automatic attack Aid Another, automatic trained-skill assistance, or an immediately usable extra swift action for an ally.

assignments.name: Talkdroid
assignments.rationale: When translating between an ally and a creature that cannot understand that ally, improves the ally's Persuasion check to change the creature's attitude.

assignments.name: Just a Scratch
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter as a reaction, reduces damage from one attack targeting Reflex Defense by an amount equal to the user's Fortitude Defense.

assignments.name: Target Lock
assignments.rationale: Maintains a Target Acquisition lock by automatically reacquiring the target as a reaction when line of sight returns and grants +5 Perception against that target's Stealth.

assignments.name: Weapons Power Surge
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, overdrives a chassis-mounted internally powered weapon for one or two extra damage dice by paying one condition-track step per added die.

assignments.name: Durable
assignments.rationale: Prevents the first encounter effect that would move the droid to the bottom of the condition track from moving it below -10; a Force Point reaction can also reduce a multi-step condition loss from one attack to a single step.

assignments.name: Load Launcher
assignments.rationale: Grants proficiency with improvised thrown weapons, expands throwable object size and range from Strength, and adds Strength bonus to damage.

assignments.name: Task Optimization
assignments.rationale: For one selected trained skill, once per encounter performs an eligible application one action category faster, never faster than a swift action.

assignments.name: Quick Modifications
assignments.rationale: When creating a field-created weapon, applies one Tech Specialist weapon modification at creation, extending rapid weapon crafting with a direct equipment modification.

assignments.name: Undying Loyalty
assignments.rationale: Improves every follower's durability by granting each the Toughness feat.

assignments.name: Coordinated Tactics
assignments.rationale: Grants every qualifying follower Coordinated Attack, improving coordinated attacks among the user's followers.

assignments.name: Exploit Weakness
assignments.rationale: After Assault Tactics marks a target, each allied damaging hit cumulatively lowers that target's Reflex Defense, making subsequent attacks against it progressively easier.

assignments.name: Ambush
assignments.rationale: A successful hit against an opponent that has not yet acted in combat deals two extra damage dice, rewarding opening attacks without requiring an actual surprise round.

assignments.name: Hunt the Hunter
assignments.rationale: A standard-action active search for hidden enemies also grants one melee or ranged attack against an enemy revealed by that Perception check.

assignments.name: Keep Them at Bay
assignments.rationale: Using Aid Another to suppress an enemy imposes a -5 penalty on that enemy's next attack instead of the normal -2.

assignments.name: Automated Strike
assignments.rationale: A swift-action Knowledge (tactics) check temporarily grants all droid allies that can hear the user the benefits of Double Attack for one proficient weapon group.

assignments.name: Droid Mettle
assignments.rationale: Once per turn as a swift action, grants one visible droid ally bonus hit points equal to 10 plus class level.

assignments.name: Inspire Competence
assignments.rationale: Once per turn as a swift action, grants one visible droid ally a class-level-scaling competence bonus on its next attack and lets Networked Mind targets count as having a heuristic processor when beneficial.

assignments.name: Maintain Focus
assignments.rationale: Once per turn as a swift action, lets all visible droid allies use Recover with two swift actions instead of three, accelerating positive condition-track recovery.

assignments.name: Overclocked Troops
assignments.rationale: Once per turn, a swift action lets every networked droid ally immediately move up to its speed.

assignments.name: Reinforced Commands
assignments.rationale: Improves commands that grant a droid ally a morale or insight bonus by increasing the granted bonus by 1.

assignments.name: Unbalancing Adaptation
assignments.rationale: When Adapt and Survive copies a morale or insight bonus, also denies that triggering bonus to one visible enemy, turning the enemy's temporary advantage into a controlled debuff.

assignments.name: Surprising Weapons
assignments.rationale: A hit with an amphistaff, thud bug, or razor bug that also beats Will Defense leaves the target flat-footed against the user through the next turn.

assignments.name: Adapt and Survive
assignments.rationale: Whenever a visible enemy receives a morale or insight bonus, the user copies that bonus through the end of the next turn.

assignments.name: Cloak of Shadow
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point as a swift action to create an encounter-long state in which moving at least 3 squares grants concealment until the next turn.

assignments.name: Phantasm
assignments.rationale: After successfully affecting a target with a mind-affecting Force power, a Force Point and swift action create phantoms that give the user and visible allies concealment from that target.

assignments.name: Revelation
assignments.rationale: A standard-action Use the Force check against Will exposes a concealed enemy and removes that target's concealment bonus to Reflex Defense through the next turn.

assignments.name: Shadow Armor
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants a Force bonus to Reflex Defense, with repeated selections scaling the bonus up to +4.

assignments.name: Shadow Vision
assignments.rationale: A swift action grants low-light vision and allows the user to ignore ordinary concealment from darkness for five minutes or the encounter.

assignments.name: Reading the Flame
assignments.rationale: While using farseeing or Search Your Feelings, rerolls the Use the Force check and keeps the better result, representing flame-mediated divination.

assignments.name: Sword of Vahl
assignments.rationale: Grants a Force bonus on attack rolls with simple weapons, improving accuracy across simple melee and ranged weapons.

assignments.name: Vahl's Brand
assignments.rationale: Changes the additional damage from an empowered weapon into fire damage, modifying the damage behavior of the empowered weapon.

assignments.name: Vahl's Flame
assignments.rationale: A swift action wreathes the user's melee weapon in flame so every successful melee attack through the next turn deals an extra 1d6 damage.

assignments.name: Wealth of Allies
assignments.rationale: When one of the user's minions is killed, a same-level replacement arrives 24 hours later, restoring the character's minion resource.

assignments.name: Bodyguard II
assignments.rationale: When Bodyguard I redirects an attack to a minion, that minion gains a defense bonus equal to half the user's class level against the redirected attack.

assignments.name: Bodyguard III
assignments.rationale: When Bodyguard I redirects an attack, the minion may immediately counterattack in melee or at range, and Bodyguard II's defense bonus increases to the user's full class level.

assignments.name: Punch Through
assignments.rationale: When the user pilots a vehicle, smaller vehicles take a -10 penalty rather than -5 on Pilot checks made to engage it in a dogfight, making engagement substantially harder.

assignments.name: Better Lucky than Dead
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter as a reaction, grants a +5 luck bonus to any one defense until the start of the user's next turn.

assignments.name: Inspire Wrath
assignments.rationale: A standard action designates one enemy as the object of allied wrath, granting allies morale bonuses to attack rolls and skill checks against that target while they retain line of sight.

assignments.name: Labyrinthine Mind
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter as a reaction, becomes immune to harmful mind-affecting effects through the next turn and removes harmful mind-affecting effects already present.

assignments.name: Crushing Assault
assignments.rationale: After damaging an opponent with a specialized bludgeoning weapon, the user's next attack against that opponent before the encounter ends gains +2 to both attack and damage; multiple triggers do not stack.

assignments.name: Uncanny Luck
assignments.rationale: Once per encounter, treats one d20 roll of 16 or higher as a natural 20.

assignments.name: Flanking Fire
assignments.rationale: While flanked and wielding two pistols, compresses a qualifying multi-target full attack from a full-round action to a standard action.

assignments.name: Keep Them Reeling
assignments.rationale: A standard-action melee hit deals no damage but forces the target to move or withdraw away from the user on its next turn.

assignments.name: Risk for Reward
assignments.rationale: Once per turn, being damaged by an attack of opportunity triggers a reaction attack against any target in range.

assignments.name: Noble Sacrifice
assignments.rationale: When a successfully recruited target is defeated by someone other than the user or allies, a reaction grants the user and all visible allies class-level-scaling bonus hit points.

assignments.name: Bolstered Numbers
assignments.rationale: Successfully recruiting an enemy grants the user and all visible allies a +2 morale bonus to attack rolls for the rest of the encounter.

assignments.name: Destructive Ambusher
assignments.rationale: After designating a prime target, every attack against that target deals one extra damage die for the rest of the encounter.

assignments.name: Luck Favors the Bold
assignments.rationale: At the start of each turn, remaining exposed to an aware visible enemy without cover grants level-scaled bonus hit points while the user remains conscious.

assignments.name: Stay in the Fight
assignments.rationale: A successfully recruited target that can catch a second wind may immediately do so as a reaction, producing immediate healing and recovery.

assignments.name: Empower Siang Lance
assignments.rationale: Spends a Force Point and a full-round action to permanently empower a siang lance for the user, adding one damage die whenever the user wields it.

assignments.name: Shield Gauntlet Redirect
assignments.rationale: After successfully deflecting a blaster bolt with an active shield gauntlet, immediately redirects it as a ranged attack against another visible target within 6 squares.

assignments.name: Personalized Modifications
assignments.rationale: A standard action tunes a powered weapon for the remainder of the encounter, granting persistent equipment bonuses to attack and damage with that weapon, including vehicle and starship weapons.

assignments.name: Vehicle Focus
assignments.rationale: For one vehicle type, improves vehicle-weapon attack rolls as pilot or gunner and allows taking 10 on Pilot checks even under circumstances that normally prevent it.

assignments.name: Fleet Tactics
assignments.rationale: A standard-action tactics check designates one vehicle for a coordinated assault, causing all visible allied gunners to deal one extra damage die per successful ranged hit until the next turn; the effect is mind-affecting.

unresolvedTagConcepts.name: Quick Study
unresolvedTagConcepts.reason: Copies an enemy non-Force talent for use on the next turn. Existing counterattack/reaction/support tags are materially incomplete or misleading for the core mimicry mechanic.
unresolvedTagConcepts.neededConcept: Temporary access to a talent/ability the character does not possess, including copied enemy talents. No new tag is authorized yet.

unresolvedTagConcepts.name: Done It All
unresolvedTagConcepts.reason: Selects two qualifying talents the character does not possess, then spends a Force Point to gain one temporarily. Existing Force/resource/action tags describe the activation cost but not the defining mechanic of temporary talent access.

claudeExecutionContract.instruction: Do not execute this rolling file until the owner/system designers mark it FINAL_FOR_EXECUTION. When enabled, mutate only the listed canonical talents and set system.tags exactly to finalTags. Deferred entries must not be changed. [Execution enabled by owner authorization recorded in executionAuthorization.]

principles: Remove tags inferred only from talent-tree, class, prestige-class, or sourcebook identity.
Use skill_substitution only for substitution of one skill/check basis for another, not for replacing an ability modifier.
Use reliability for rerolls, take-10/automatic-success, fixed-result, or comparable outcome-stabilizing mechanics rather than generic numerical bonuses or action compression.
Use condition_removal/recovery for actual positive condition-track movement or removal of ongoing adverse effects, not merely prevention or reduction of future condition loss.
Use sustained_damage only when the mechanic actually improves repeated/ongoing damage output.
Prefer direct mechanical scope over prerequisite/flavor-derived tags.

Scum and Villainy.reason: DJVU/TXT OCR materially corrupted talent names and wording.

revisions.name: Charm Beast
revisions.reason: Core and Jedi Academy explicitly identify Charm Beast as the same talent. Normalize to the direct mechanic: Force-based Persuasion substitution against beasts, with social manipulation/control; remove broad `nature` leakage.

revisions.name: Notorious
revisions.reason: The two Core Notorious records have the same intimidation-reroll mechanic. The text does not explicitly make the talent itself a mind-affecting effect, so remove the inconsistent `mind-affecting` tag.

revisions.name: Shift Defense II
revisions.reason: Shift Defense I–III are one progression with the same defensive trade mechanic. Normalize to action/defense/setup semantics; generic survivability/resilience overstates the mechanic.

revisions.name: Shift Defense III
revisions.reason: Shift Defense I–III are one progression with the same defensive trade mechanic. Normalize to action/defense/setup semantics; generic survivability/resilience overstates the mechanic.

revisions.name: Turn the Tide
revisions.reason: Turn the Tide explicitly causes Initiative rerolls; under the tightened global rule, every actual reroll mechanic also carries `reliability`.

revisions.name: Stava Expertise
revisions.reason: Stava Expertise explicitly rerolls grapple checks; add `reliability` to match every other direct reroll mechanic.

revisions.name: Fluidity
revisions.reason: Fluidity carries applicable Acrobatics rerolls to the substituted Use the Force check; add `reliability` for reroll consistency.

revisions.name: Computer Language
revisions.reason: Computer Language transfers applicable Use Computer rerolls to Persuasion. It was the only substitution talent with this printed clause missing both `reroll` and `reliability`.

revisions.name: Past Visions
revisions.reason: Past Visions halves farseeing DCs and removes a Force Point requirement; that is difficulty/resource improvement, not reroll/fixed-result/failure-rescue reliability.

revisions.name: Devastating Attack
revisions.reason: Devastating Attack and Greater Devastating Attack are the same threshold-bypass family at different magnitudes. `precision` is reserved for attack-roll improvement, not threshold reduction.

revisions.name: Weak Point
revisions.reason: Weak Point explicitly designates one visible target before bypassing that target's DR; add `target-designation`.
